sin.name: moment-worked-out-again
sin.description: A listener or a data reader finds that something just happened by comparing a stored position or the agent's tool-use count with now, so a moment stamped at another use is missed and one seen twice is told twice.
sin.rule: Have the model name the moment as an event where the row changes, with Model.with_event, or announce it where it happens, and answer that event in the conduct once; never work the moment out again from data.
